The clinical guidelines documented in this corpus establish specific criteria for initiating [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] (anticoagulation treatment) based on the [[CHA2DS2-VASc]] risk scoring system. For incident patients, the guidelines mandate a score of ≥2 as the threshold for indicating [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] across both sexes [^src1]. This uniform cutoff is a direct consequence of the scoring methodology: the [[CHA2DS2-VASc]] calculation does not allocate any points for female sex [^src1]. 

This clinical policy has been consistently maintained in subsequent guideline updates. The continued application of the ≥2 threshold for both men and women is explicitly justified by the absence of sex-specific points in the [[CHA2DS2-VASc]] score, ensuring that the indication for [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] remains standardized regardless of the patient's gender [^src2].

## Claims
- For incidente patienter anvendes ≥2 som skæringpunkt for indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling hos begge køn, da der ikke gives point for kvindekøn i CHA2DS2-VASc-beregningen [^src1] (cha2ds2-vasc, antikoagulationsbehandling)
  Type: clinical-guideline
  Page: 87
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2023.pdf, pages 86-90
- Der er ved beregningen af CHA2DS2-VASc score ikke givet point for kvindekøn, og ≥2 er derfor anvendt som skæringpunkt for indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling hos begge køn. [^src1] (cha2ds2-vasc, antikoagulationsbehandling)
